items.s: Say the word, bark, or cry that lets loose the storm.
You unleash a violent command laced with divine current. A burst of arcing energy and
sonic force detonates outward in the direction you face.
Up to three creatures nearby each other and in range of you are struck by the discharge. Each
creature takes 3 lightning and force damage and is hurled away from you into a nearby area.
Electric arcs crawl across the ground, walls, and bodies caught in the blast.
On a result of 10 or less, the creature is Prone and Dazed until the end of its next turn. Creatures
knocked prone by this blast slide away from you into a nearby area and take 2 additional damage.
Crackling aftershocks linger for a moment in the air, the smell of ozone hanging where your
Prayer rips from your mouth like sparks off a live wire.
Speak a word or phrase of judgment and condemn a nearby creature you can see. Your
conviction erupts around the target in a violent burst of radiant fire, divine force, or
The Monoverse rejects the creature completely. Its form erupts into ash and its spirit is
The sentence lands. The target takes
until the end of its next turn, and rolls
Surreal until it rolls a Triumph or the encounter ends.
